notes.title: Balancing 1.0.4
notes.content:
The player experience didn't quite live up to the term "cozy" considering the difficulty.
Therefore, the attributes of buildings and units were changed as much as possible to make the game feel more fair for every type of player.

Three new difficulty levels have been introduced: Cozy, Default and Survival. Apart from balancing, these give a change to the health points and damage of units. 

Difficulties:


 Cozy (Preset): -20% on units, +20% on buildings and turrets
 Default: 0% change
 Survival: +20% on units, -20% on buildings and turrets


Moreover the health points of units and buildings have generally been doubled. 
The damage of units has been roughly halved. 
As a result, neither buildings nor units should no longer feel like paper.

The following values have been changed:

Tanks:


 +100% HP
 -50% damage


Aircraft units have been made slightly stronger to compensate the deficit in health points of buildings.

Zeppelins:


 +60% HP
 +10% damage


Airplanes:


 +40% HP
 +40% damage


The boss tank did too much damage, but should remain tanky. Its task is to break your base building, not your defense.

Boss Tank:


 -25% damage


Turrets:


 Rocket Turrets: Reduce Price Costs slightly to make them more valuable
 Machine Turrets: 100/200/300 -> 200/400/600 HP
 Rocket Turrets: 60/90/120 -> 100/200/300 HP
 Rocket-Gun: 15/20/40 -> 20/40/80 Damage
 Air-Rocket-Gun: 12/18/34 -> 15/30/45 Damage
 Machine Gun Turret: 18/32/64 -> 21/35/67 Damage
 +50% necessary xp amount for turret upgrades


Economy:


 Houses: 75/250/500 -> 150/350/600 HP
 Houses: +10/+10/+10 Gold income
 Factories: 100/160/300 -> 200/400/700 HP
 Factories: +5/+10/+20 Building Material
 Base Building: 500 -> 800 HP


If you feel like the game should be more easy, consider to post inside the community hub. 
The difficulty factor can be adjusted easily on the developer side.
Enjoy!

notes.title: Hotfixes 1.0.3
notes.content:
Further bugs have been fixed to improve the gaming experience.

Hotfixes:


 Tanks got stuck on curves very rarly
 It was not possible to end a round under certain circumstances
 1 level spawn in level "Mountain" didn't work


Small Enhancements:


 Improving lights inside "Desert" level
 Airplanes are cleared faster when leaving the map
 Airplanes have bigger smoke now
 Increased camera movement clamp in level "Mountain"
 Increased maximum camera zoom a little


If the listed bugs are still happening on 1.0.3, please consider to report it inside the Community Hub.
Feel free to give any further feedback!

notes.title: Hotfixes, Enhancements and Balancing 1.0.2
notes.content:
This small update should improve the player experience.

Hotfixes:


 Resolved traffic: blocking tanks
 Air rocket guns had no optimal collider 
 Increase camera movement range inside level: "Island"
 Water rendering layer was above building rendering layer
 Removing destroyed buildings did not remove fire particles
 Steam achievements did not correctly count the amount of buildings


Enhancements:


 Added a todo building list in "Forest" as a starting point (as an easier entry)
 Added a boss spawn position info before starting a boss wave
 Zeppelins & airplanes have bigger smoke particles
 Added an arrow that shows in which direction a turret is facing


Balancing:


 Nerfed tank stats: health & damage
 Nerfed aircraft stats: health & damage
 Nerfed bosses stats: damage


If you encounter more issues don't hesitate to post in the community hub.
This way we can make Dampf a better playing experience for all of us!
